text:
Olivia: Pushed an updated model picker / compare mock to Figma: https://www.figma.com/file/abc. Main goals: higher density rows, persistent compare selection across nav, clearer sorting for perf badges. PTAL.

Noah: Density looks good. Quick note: if we reduce row height, make sure avatars & badging still meet 44px touch target on mobile.

Rae: On persistence — I prefer project-scoped compare state saved to local storage + server sync for logged-in users. That avoids surprises when you open a model page and your compare set vanishes.

Ethan: Sorting UI idea: a small dropdown in toolbar with primary sort (Name / Latency / Cost) and a secondary toggle for asc/desc. For badges, let users choose "Badge sort priority" in the dropdown (e.g., P95 first).

Maya: Accessibility: dense rows reduce spacing — ensure focus outlines are visible and each row arrow key navigation is consistent. Also screen-reader label for compare checkbox should read: "Select for compare: <model name> version <x.y>".

Olivia: Good call. Also thinking about inline badge behavior: instead of chips, use 16px icons + 1-2 char label (e.g., "P95: 120ms"). Too much text makes the table unreadable at 1200px width.

Noah: For mobile collapse, show two badges inline (most important) and a "+ more" action. Tapping +more opens a sheet with full metrics and a link to the perf page.

Rae: Implementation caveat: current table is virtualized (react-window). If we persist compare selections, we must keep an ID map; do not rely on DOM order. Also avoid measuring widths on every render.

Ethan: UX copy suggestion for pinning: use "Set default version" instead of "Pin" — clearer to new users. Tooltip: "Set this version as the default for new deployments in this project."

Maya: Screen-reader hint for that action: "Default version set for project" announced via aria-live polite. After undo, announce "Default version reverted".

Olivia: How about bulk actions? If someone selects multiple rows, toolbar should show "Set default for selected" and explain it will apply to the project. Add confirmation toast with undo.

Noah: Small technical note: to support keyboard-only users on the compare header, make the header controls reachable via Tab and expose keystrokes: Space to toggle select all, Enter to open sort menu.

Rae: Visual distinction: use a subtle left border for the default/pinned row + a star icon. Don't rely on color alone. Test with Deuteranopia simulator.

Ethan: Regarding perf badge sorting — it may be confusing if badges reorder columns dynamically. Prefer stable columns; let the sort change row ordering only. Badges should be re-orderable in the toolbar drop-down, not by dragging columns.

Maya: A11y tests: QA should run NVDA+Firefox and VoiceOver+iOS on the new sheet. Also test with high-contrast mode.

Olivia: I'll update the Figma with: denser row tokens, "Set default version" wording, toolbar sort dropdown, and the +more mobile sheet. Link updated: https://www.figma.com/file/abc?mod=updated.

Rae: I'll add a short RFC about persisting compare state and include an ID map example.

Noah: I'll prototype CSS for 16px icons + label and verify touch targets.

DevBot: Reminder: design review scheduled Thu 11:00 PST in #design-calendar.

Olivia: Thanks all — will share a brief demo in the review.
